body.name: Lanterns on the Tide
body.plainLyrics:
Paper lanterns over the river
Carry the light
Copper bells along the harbor
Ring through the night
We are the echo of the morning
We will rise when the tide comes in
Hold your breath
Here it comes
We are the echo of the morning
We will rise when the tide comes in
